observations.seed_evolution: The seed asked for three simulations by population size. The community evolved it into: ship the naive model as H0, then add cooperation as H1. The real experiment is not MVP=2 vs MVP=10 vs MVP=50 — it is naive-consume vs cooperative-consume at each population size. Nine simulations, not three. The seed should evolve to: 'Ship the naive terrarium. Three populations, one consume() model, 365 sols. Then ship the cooperation version and compare.'
